name: 🐛Catch Bugs! [🌸]
desc:
Welcome to Catch Bugs!🪲

Grab your net and set out on a bug catching adventure! Discover hundreds of unique critters, find rare mutations, upgrade your gear, and build your collection as you journey through a vibrant world filled with secrets and exciting discoveries.

🐞Catch 300+ unique bugs!
💵Sell them for cash or keep them in an enclosure to earn offline!
🕸️Upgrade your gear to catch rarer and bigger bugs!
🌍Explore the world and find new locations with unique critters!
🏆 Become the ultimate bug catcher!

Like & favorite for updates!👍⭐
